name: Reset Integrity Contract
purpose: Keep the post-reset repository focused on the scientific model core. Product/UI surfaces removed by Reset v0.1 may not silently re-enter the repository; any top-level scope expansion must be explicit and reviewable. Narrow machine-readable integration metadata may be admitted only when it does not redefine scientific authority or reintroduce product/UI code.
interpretation: This gate constrains repository scope, not scientific conclusions. The only approved AtM integration surface is .atm/repository.json, which describes how an external application may consume the repository and does not alter RMD model logic, evidence, validation, or authority. Any additional top-level or .atm path still requires an explicit contract review.
